A video of a ‘weird’ object hovering in the sky was shared on social media, leaving the internet taking all kinds of guesses over what the object could be! Take a look…

Conspiracy Theories Take Over As Woman Records ‘Weird Object’ In Sky. Image Source: _meenal.verma_/ Instagram

Aliens and UFO conspiracy theorists and enthusiasts are having a field day on the internet, as a rather interesting video allegedly from Punjab recently surfaced online and immediately went viral over its ‘mystery’. The video was shared by a woman who claimed to have spotted an unexplainable object hovering in the sky, allegedly in Jalandhar.

Allegedly, the woman first spotted the object in the sky at around 3:30 PM. However, at 5:25 PM, she spotted it again, hovering in the same area. She further claimed that it looked like a kite from a distance– but was something else in reality.

“I was going somewhere at around 3:30 PM when I saw it. It was in the sky. It’s 5:25 PM now, and this thing is still here, and I don’t know what it is. It is very weird. From a certain distance, it looks like a kite, but if you focus and zoom in, you’ll see that it’s something else entirely,” the woman said in the video.

The video soon went viral, with netizens chiming in as people began sharing their speculations. Times Now could not confirm the details or the authenticity of the post.

Check out the viral post:

“Who saw this in Jalandhar? I have been watching for the last 2 hours. Is this?” the post read.

The post was shared on Instagram, by the handle ‘_meenal.verma_’. The post was shared a day ago and pulled over 8K views from netizens.

Internet’s reactions:

“This is NASA's Advanced Composite Solar Sail System (ACS3),” a user said. “Fanally, an alien sighting in India as well. I thought they loved to only visit the US,” added another person. “It's a kite, so many are there in the Jalandhar city sky, just saw,” added another.

“Aliens are coming to Punjab,” joked another person. “Conspiracy video always recorded by calculator or landline phone. Why are you not zooming in properly?” asked the next. “Ohhhh I saw that yesterday and thought it was a kite, and it stayed in our sky till after,” added another internet user in the comments.
